stations.label: Stations
stations.description: One station per line: name | stream URL | Radioplayer id, with an optional | logo URL at the end. The Radioplayer id is the country code and the station id, such as 056/5067. The README explains how to find it.

manifest.name: Radioplayer
manifest.description: Radio stations you list, showing the artist, title and cover of what plays now from the public Radioplayer feed.
